title: Resonance and damping
summary: Field-guide chapter 3: the driven damped linear oscillator, RK4-integrated over the augmented state [x, v, t]. Steady-state amplitude and phase, the closed-form underdamped transient, the resonance peak and quality factor, validated case by case against an independent Python reference. A pendulum toggle (extending research/R002-pendulum-driven/code/) shows where the linear model folds over.

sources: French, Vibrations and Waves, MIT Introductory Physics Series, 1971, ch. 4
Feynman, Leighton & Sands, The Feynman Lectures on Physics, Vol. I, ch. 23-24
Marion & Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems, 5th ed., ch. 3
